title: What is a Base Resume - Resume Builder - Content Management & Career History
description:
**What is a Base Resume?** 

In today's video, we're diving deep into the concept of a **Base Resume**—your ultimate career document!  Whether you're using Google Docs, Microsoft Word, or any document editor, having a comprehensive record of all your accomplishments is crucial.

 **What You'll Learn:**
- The importance of a Base Resume (formerly known as a master resume)
- How to tailor your resume for different job applications without starting from scratch
- Tips for managing your career history efficiently
- Using the Teal Resume Builder to streamline your resume creation

 **Why is a Base Resume Important?**
A Base Resume helps you keep track of everything you've ever done, allowing you to easily pick and choose relevant experiences for specific positions. You can create different views for your resumes while maintaining your core information, making it simpler to adjust content as you apply for various roles.

 **Key Features:**
- Add, edit, and save multiple career bullets effortlessly
- Duplicate and modify resumes without losing your original data
- Customize templates, layouts, and formats to match job requirements
- Learn how syncing and version control can enhance your resume management

Join us as we explore how a Base Resume can simplify your job search and increase your chances of landing interviews!  Leave your questions or thoughts in the comments below, and don’t forget to subscribe for more career-building tips! 

 **Stay Tuned:**
Watch till the end for an overview of our upcoming module on syncing and how to manage variations in your resumes effectively!
